response.original_title: Evil Ned 3: The Return Of Evil Ned 2 Electric Boogaloo
response.overview: An evil monster who was once human rises from the grave as an even more evil monster zombie. He launches a plan to take over the world under the control of his master. The monster zombie plans to use ancient underwear, feces, and evil ducks to accomplish his mission. It's up to a superhero to stop him
response.tagline: From the bowels of acclaimed heavy metal drummer (ex-ICED EARTH, DEATH, LEASH LAW, CONTROL DENIED), and Howard Stern regular Richard Christy, comes this awesome, cheesy piece of "cinema"
